summary: One 4:3 gradient file rendered in three boxes: ratio 16/9 (cropped), ratio 1 (cropped) and ratio 1 with fit contain (letterboxed).
use: Card covers, thumbnails and avatar grids where every picture must share one box whatever its own proportions.
spec: `src` is an inlined 4:3 `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,` gradient with a circle
Each image sits in a `<figure>` with a `<figcaption>` naming its ratio
